title: Glowing telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tube' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4de1ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2b8fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb43d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tripod -->
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='30' y2='94' stroke='#9a6b3f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='70' y2='94' stroke='#c0894f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='50' y2='95' stroke='#b57a45' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- central pivot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='9' fill='#7fd6ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='5' fill='#2b8fd6'/>
  <!-- tube -->
  <g transform='rotate(-32 50 62)'>
    <rect x='18' y='55' width='64' height='16' rx='8' fill='url(#tube)'/>
    <rect x='18' y='55' width='64' height='6' rx='3' fill='#a8f0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- eyepiece -->
    <rect x='74' y='57' width='12' height='12' rx='5' fill='#1f6fb0'/>
    <rect x='78' y='59' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4de1ff'/>
    <!-- lens front -->
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='63' rx='5' ry='8' fill='url(#glow)'/>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='63' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- glow rays from lens -->
  <g stroke='#ffe57a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='14' y1='40' x2='10' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='28' y1='36' x2='30' y2='27'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='34' x2='19' y2='25'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='10' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#ffe57a'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='23' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
</svg>
